title.zh: 比特币钱包厂商 Keystone 停售设备：工厂密钥被盗为仿冒品打开大门
title.en: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes

current_state.zh:
Keystone 周一表示，将销毁 18,835 台未售出的硬件钱包，并暂停所有官网未发货订单的配送，原因是攻击者获取了其设备用于验证真伪的永久性工厂 WebAuth 密钥。该事件于 10 月 20 日被发现，同时泄露了其 Shopify 商店中 25,964 条 2024 年至 2026 年的买家记录，包括姓名、联系方式、收货地址和订单信息。

由于被盗密钥正是 Keystone 官网验证页面所依赖的凭据，仿冒设备可能通过真伪校验并被卖给用户，而用户可能在其上存入真实资产；Keystone 表示这类设备可能被当作正品 unknowingly 使用，“可能导致资产被盗”。该公司称助记词和私钥未受影响，10 月 20 日之前交付的设备不受影响。

Keystone 称共涉及 51,083 条买家记录，但其中 25,119 条的个人信息已被清除，剩余 25,964 条仍保留数据——公司将这一保留超期归因于自动批量删除任务失败且未被及时发现，违背了其 180 天删除政策。通过亚马逊及其他渠道的购买未受影响；在采用新密钥的设备投产前，官网销售将转为预售，Keystone 表示已向欧盟、英国等司法辖区的有关部门提交报告，并提醒任何以“召回”为名要求用户寄回设备的人都是骗子。
current_state.en: Keystone is destroying 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping after an attacker obtained the permanent factory key used to verify its devices are genuine, while 25,964 customer records from its Shopify store were also exposed.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Keystone is destroying 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping after an attacker obtained the permanent factory key used to verify its devices are genuine, while 25,964 customer records from its Shopify store were also exposed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Keystone is destroying 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping after an attacker obtained the permanent factory key used to verify its devices are genuine, while 25,964 customer records from its Shopify store were also exposed.
updates.background_zh: 客户名单一直是硬件钱包厂商反复出现的薄弱环节：Ledger 2020 年的泄露事件最终波及约 29.2 万名客户，Trezor 和 SafePal 也分别在 8 月披露客户数据泄露，涉及 13,689 名和约 39,798 名客户。姓名与地址之所以敏感，是因为存在“扳手攻击”——犯罪分子以威胁或暴力迫使持有者交出加密资产；Chainalysis 统计 2026 年上半年共发生 46 起暴力攻击，被盗金额超过 3000 万美元。
updates.background_en: Customer lists have been a recurring weak point for hardware-wallet makers: Ledger's 2020 leak eventually reached about 292,000 customers, and Trezor and SafePal each disclosed customer-data breaches in August affecting 13,689 and about 39,798 customers respectively. Names and addresses matter because of "wrench attacks," in which criminals use threats or violence to force owners to hand over crypto; Chainalysis counted 46 violent attacks in the first half of 2026, with more than $30 million stolen.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于对设备来源的信任，而非流动性或比特币供给：二级市场和转售的 Keystone 设备如今带有买家无法通过厂商自带校验来排除的真伪风险，这可能使需求转向直接从厂商购买或转向其他品牌。Keystone 称私钥和助记词未受影响，目前也不存在已知的资金被盗，因此对比特币价格的直接传导有限。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through trust in device provenance rather than liquidity or bitcoin supply: secondary-market and resale Keystone units now carry authentication risk that buyers cannot resolve with the vendor's own check, which may shift demand toward devices bought directly from manufacturers or toward competitors. Keystone says no private keys or recovery phrases were affected and no funds are known stolen, which limits any direct read-through to BTC prices.
